title: Temperature Volatility Anomaly
scenario: Flag days where the daily temperature change (vs previous day) is more than 3 standard deviations from the city's annual average change.
tableSchema: weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC)
hint: Calculate daily diff with LAG(), then compute global avg/stddev of that diff.
correctQuery: SELECT city_name, reading_date FROM (SELECT city_name, reading_date, change, AVG(change) OVER(PARTITION BY city_name) as mu, STDDEV(change) OVER(PARTITION BY city_name) as sigma FROM (SELECT city_name, reading_date, (temp_c - LAG(temp_c) OVER(PARTITION BY city_name ORDER BY reading_date)) as change FROM weather_data) t) t2 WHERE ABS(change - mu) > 3 * sigma;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE weather_data (city_name VARCHAR, reading_date DATE, temp_c NUMERIC);
